e2e.testName: P3-E2E-01: a settled provider failure retains the same typed outcome and evidence after Engine replacement

execution.hostFixture: real Rust Lifecycle Host with deterministic custody fixture

assertions: The Run and Attempt identity is preserved across Engine replacement.
The typed outcome identity and classification remain stable.
Evidence references still resolve after replacement.
No duplicate terminal outcome is created.

e2e.testName: P3-03/P3-22: provider authentication failure is typed without copying credential-shaped diagnostics

execution.hostFixture: real Rust Lifecycle Host with deterministic custody fixture

assertions: The authentication failure produces a typed provider outcome.
Credential-shaped diagnostic text is excluded from the typed summary.

e2e.testName: P3-E2E-02: Rust Host failure evidence reconciles after Engine absence without a second launch

execution.hostFixture: real Rust Lifecycle Host with deterministic custody fixture

assertions: The same Custody invocation is reconciled after Engine replacement.
Host terminal and spool evidence are retained.
The appropriate typed outcome is durable.
No second provider launch or duplicate outcome occurs.

e2e.testName: P3-E2E-03: a temporary Host outage stays uncertain, then reconciles the same outcome when the process completes

execution.hostFixture: real Rust Lifecycle Host with deterministic custody fixture

assertions: Host unavailability does not create terminal proof.
Execution and side-effect uncertainty remain explicit and the workspace stays held.
Later authoritative Host evidence updates the same outcome identity.
No blind replay or duplicate launch occurs.
